idiom.title: On a treadmill
idiom.glossZh: “像在跑步机上” 或 “重复且无效的努力”。
idiom.interpretationEn: This phrase originates from the experience of using a treadmill. On a treadmill, no matter how hard you run, you don’t actually make any forward progress; you stay in the same place. This vividly describes a state of futile effort where there is a repetitive action but no substantive progress, commonly used to describe ineffective cycles in life or work.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语起源于跑步机的使用体验。在跑步机上，无论你多么努力奔跑，其实并没有前进，仍旧停留在原地。这形象地描述了一种徒劳无功、重复努力却没有实质性进展的状态，常用来形容生活或工作中的无效循环。

examples.en: I feel like I’m just on a treadmill with these endless meetings and no real results.
examples.zh: 我感觉这些无休止的会议没有实际成果，就像在跑步机上一样徒劳。

examples.en: Working in customer service sometimes feels like being on a treadmill, handling the same complaints day after day.
examples.zh: 在客服部门工作有时就像是在跑步机上，每天处理相同的投诉。

examples.en: She realized she was on a treadmill in her relationship, always trying but getting nowhere.
examples.zh: 她意识到她的感情生活像在跑步机上一样，总是付出努力却没有进展。

people.name: Jim Redman
people.extract: James Albert Redman,  is a Rhodesian former professional motorcycle racer. He competed in Grand Prix motorcycle racing from 1959 to 1966. Redman is notable for being a six-time Grand Prix road racing world champion. In 2012, the F.I.M. inducted Redman into the MotoGP Hall of Fame.
highlights: Six-time Grand Prix road racing world champion.
Inducted into the MotoGP Hall of Fame.

people.name: Stéphane Audran
people.extract: Stéphane Audran was a French film actress. She was known for her performances in the films of her husband Claude Chabrol, including Les Biches (1968) and Le Boucher (1970), Luis Buñuel's The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie (1972), and Gabriel Axel's Babette's Feast (1987). The role she was mostly associated with was that of the haughty bourgeois woman.
highlights: Starred in Claude Chabrol's Les Biches and Le Boucher.
Appeared in Luis Buñuel's The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie.
Also known for Gabriel Axel's Babette's Feast.

people.name: Alfre Woodard
people.extract: Alfre LaWanda Jeen Woodard is an American actress and producer. Known for portraying strong-willed and dignified roles on stage and screen, she has received various accolades, including four Emmy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and three Screen Actors Guild Awards as well as nominations for an Academy Award, BAFTA Award, and two Grammy Awards. In 2020, The New York Times ranked her as one of "The 25 Greatest Actors of the 21st Century". She is a board member of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.
highlights: Won four Emmy Awards and a Golden Globe.
Received three Screen Actors Guild Awards.
Named one of "The 25 Greatest Actors of the 21st Century".
